items.exampleEn: The ending of the film felt rushed and unconvincing.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影的結局感覺倉促又沒有說服力。
items.glossZh: 沒有說服力的；難以置信的

items.exampleEn: He played the buffoon at parties to hide how shy he was.
items.exampleZh: 他在派對上扮小丑，來掩飾自己的害羞。

items.exampleEn: Bad weather never daunts the town's fishermen.
items.exampleZh: 壞天氣從來嚇不倒這個鎮上的漁夫。

items.exampleEn: It was tactful of you not to mention her new haircut.
items.exampleZh: 你沒提起她的新髮型，真是很得體。
items.glossZh: 圓融得體的；說話有分寸的

items.exampleEn: The article was provocatively titled "Why Homework Should End."
items.exampleZh: 那篇文章下了個很挑釁的標題：「為什麼作業應該廢除」。

items.exampleEn: The owners were neglectful, and the garden turned into a jungle.
items.exampleZh: 屋主疏於照顧，花園變成了一片叢林。

items.exampleEn: She conscientiously checked every figure in the report.
items.exampleZh: 她認真負責地檢查報告裡的每一個數字。
items.glossZh: 認真盡責地；一絲不苟地

items.exampleEn: She gave me an impish grin and ran off with my hat.
items.exampleZh: 她對我露出頑皮的笑，拿著我的帽子就跑了。

items.sentenceEn: The long, steep climb did not daunt the young walkers at all.
items.sentenceZh: 又長又陡的山路一點也沒有嚇倒那些年輕的健行者。

items.audioEn: His excuse for missing the meeting was so unconvincing that nobody believed him.
items.audioZh: 他缺席會議的藉口太沒說服力，沒有人相信他。
items.questionZh: 大家怎麼看他缺席會議的理由？
options: They thought it was a good reason.

items.sentenceEn: My son works conscientiously, even when no one is watching.
items.sentenceZh: 就算沒有人在看，我兒子也認真盡責地工作。

items.sentenceEn: A tactful reply can calm down an angry customer.
items.sentenceZh: 得體的回應可以讓生氣的客人冷靜下來。

items.stemEn: The witness's story was ____, so the police kept asking more questions.
items.stemZh: 證人的說法沒有說服力，所以警方一直追問。

items.stemEn: Don't let the size of the project ____ you; we'll do it step by step.
items.stemZh: 別被這個專案的規模嚇倒，我們一步一步來。

items.passageEn: When Ms. Park took over the school drama club, the size of the task did not daunt her. The previous teacher had been neglectful, and the costumes were full of holes. She chose a comedy about a king who behaves like a buffoon, and even the most timid students joined. Lucas, an impish boy who loved to make others laugh, got the main role. At first his acting was unconvincing, because he kept laughing at his own jokes. Ms. Park was tactful: instead of criticizing him in front of others, she spoke to him after class. From then on, he practiced his lines conscientiously every day. On opening night, the final scene, which asked provocatively whether a foolish king is worse than a cruel one, started long conversations among the parents.
items.passageZh: Park 老師接手學校戲劇社時，工作量之大並沒有嚇倒她。前一位老師疏於管理，戲服滿是破洞。她選了一齣喜劇，講一位舉止像小丑的國王，連最膽小的學生都加入了。頑皮又愛逗別人笑的 Lucas 拿到了主角。一開始他的演技沒什麼說服力，因為他老是被自己的笑話逗笑。Park 老師很得體：她沒有在大家面前批評他，而是下課後私下跟他談。從那以後，他每天都認真地排練。首演當晚，最後一幕挑釁地提出一個問題：愚蠢的國王是否比殘忍的國王更糟？這在家長之間引發了長時間的討論。

questions.questionZh: Park 老師怎麼處理 Lucas 的問題？
options: 把主角換給另一位同學演
在全班面前指出他的錯誤

questions.questionZh: 演出的最後一幕引發了什麼？
options: 觀眾起立鼓掌了整整十分鐘
家長之間的長時間討論

items.promptZh: 他工作太忙，對家人有些疏忽。
referenceEn: He is so busy with work that he has been a little neglectful of his family.
Because he is very busy at work, he is somewhat neglectful of his family.
rubricZh: 「疏忽的」用 neglectful，例如 be neglectful of his family 等
「太忙」可寫，例如 so busy…that、because he is very busy 等
「有些」可寫，例如 a little、somewhat 等；時態配合內容（例如 is、has been）

items.promptZh: 這位喜劇演員有一種頑皮的幽默感。
referenceEn: This comedian has an impish sense of humor.
The comedian's sense of humor is impish.
rubricZh: 「頑皮的」用 impish（例如 an impish sense of humor 等）
「幽默感」可寫，例如 sense of humor 等
